customManagers.description: Digest-pinned images used through docker run in workflow steps
BuildKit image used by the release and CI buildx builders (setup-buildx-action driver-opts), pinned by digest
binfmt image that setup-qemu-action runs in the release job (its image input), pinned by digest. Only qemu-vX.Y.Z tags are versions, so the build-number aliases are ignored
The go.mod go directive and the Dockerfile GO_VERSION argument follow the golang builder image tag, so a Go release updates all three together (scripts/check-go-toolchain.sh rejects a partial update)

packageRules.description: Group digest-only refreshes of pinned images and actions into one weekly PR and merge it automatically once required CI checks pass. A group that contains a GitHub Actions or release-builder digest is not automerged, because Renovate automerges a group only when every upgrade in it is automerge-eligible.
A GitHub Actions digest refresh means an action tag was re-pointed, so it waits for a reviewer instead of automerging. pinDigest is included so that pinning an action to a SHA is reviewed too.
BuildKit and binfmt run in the release job, which holds packages: write and id-token: write, so their digest refreshes wait for a reviewer like the GitHub Actions digests above.

Hold Docker digest refreshes until seven days after the tag was last pushed. Renovate reads release timestamps only from Docker Hub; a registry without them (GHCR) stays pending under timestamp-required, so its digest refreshes are not proposed automatically.
Give new Go module releases time to be retracted before they are proposed.
The regex manager above owns the go directive, so the gomod manager does not propose it separately.
One PR per Go release: the builder image, the go directive, and GO_VERSION must change together.
